shared_elements: carved stone surface with relief motifs
large upright/vertical anthropomorphic form dominating the field
incised low-relief linework on a weathered stone ground
paired symmetrical elements arranged around a central axis
repeated small motifs filling the field
justification: Both are weathered stone works whose surfaces carry shallow incised relief organised around a dominant upright, roughly bilaterally symmetrical body, and each includes a distinct circular/ring motif plus paired flanking shapes. But A is a flat rectangular wall panel with a crisply cut, highly detailed profile figure beside a filled plant motif and a ruled band of dense script, whereas B is a fully three-dimensional monolithic sculpture whose ornament is coarse, eroded and subordinate to the massive carved volume — the manner of cutting and the whole format differ fundamentally.
